reference.title: Prerequisites
reference.shortdesc: To use the BACnet drivers, your installation needs to meet specific requirements.

li.p: A license for the bacnet feature for each host including an optional Supervisor station running on a PC.
BACnet device and proxy point limits may exist in your license.
One or more 64–bit computers to serve as Supervisors; the latest version of requires 64–bit computers.
A target host controller running the Framework or later.
running on a PC and enabled to be used as an installation tool.
A network of installed BACnet devices.

section.p: In addition, to use the EDE (Engineering Data Exchange) utility to discover BACnet devices and points offline:

li.p: EDE configuration files that are compatible with the EDE 2.2 specification, stored in the local file system and accessible to .
